title: Quote: The point is that people really don't have to understand how...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: The point is that people really don't have to understand how computers work. Most people have no concept of how an automatic transmission works, yet they know how to drive a car. You don't have to study physics to understand the laws of motion to drive a car. You don't have to understand any of this stuff to use Macintosh
